annotation.bound_parties_text: The practice is written for all small unmanned aircraft systems (sUAS) seeking permission to operate BVLOS, i.e. their operators; compliance is only recommended and application is at the CAA's discretion.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: This practice is written for all sUAS seeking permission to operate BVLOS (E) or BVLOS, or both, in airspace authorized by a CAA.
annotation.legal_effect_quote: Compliance with this practice is recommended as one means of seeking approval from a civil aviation authority (CAA) to operate a small unmanned aircraft system (sUAS) beyond visual line of sight (BVLOS).
annotation.robot_provision_quote: ASTM F3196-18 Standard Practice for Seeking Approval for Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) Small Unmanned Aircraft System (sUAS) Operations
